responsibility: Defines the x86 AVX-IFMA intrinsic interface for 128-bit and 256-bit integer fused multiply-add on packed 64-bit lanes outside the AVX-512 IFMA family. It provides wrappers for madd52 high/low operations with AVX-width vectors, giving GCC a separate public API for the newer AVXIFMA extension rather than reusing the AVX-512 IFMA headers.
